name: Is it better to convert existing interior space or build an exterior addition for a new bathroom?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to convert existing interior space or build an exterior addition for a new bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adding a bathroom inside existing walls converts underutilized space quickly, whereas building a home addition preserves interior living area at a higher financial investment. Converting an oversized hallway closet, basement storage room, or spare bedroom avoids foundation work, siding changes, and roof modifications. However, you sacrifice storage or living volume. An exterior bump-out preserves your current layout and allows complete freedom over room dimensions, but requires structural engineering, building envelope tie-ins, and larger trade scopes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Converting interior space costs less and finishes faster but takes away living or closet space. Building an exterior bump-out protects your layout but requires foundation and roof work.
